SELECT a.LEDGER_ID, a.TASK_ID, a.QUESTION_ID_1, a.QUESTION_DSCR_1, a.QUESTION_ID_2, a.QUESTION_DSCR_2, a.QUESTION_ID_3, a.QUESTION_DSCR_3, a.QUESTION_ID, a.QUESTION_DSCR, a.QUESTION_OPINIONS, a.BACK_REASON, a.QUESTION_CONTENT, a.ERROR_TYPE, CASE WHEN a.MEASURES IS NOT NULL AND a.MEASURES <> '' THEN a.MEASURES WHEN a.MEASURES IS NULL OR a.MEASURES ='' THEN CASE WHEN CONCAT(rls.COMPLETE_TIME,rls.REFORM_SCHEME,rls.MEMO) IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(rls.COMPLETE_TIME,rls.REFORM_SCHEME,rls.MEMO) <> '' THEN CONCAT(rls.COMPLETE_TIME,rls.REFORM_SCHEME,rls.MEMO) ELSE '' END END AS MEASURES, CASE WHEN (a.MEASURES IS NOT NULL AND a.MEASURES <> '') OR (CONCAT(rls.COMPLETE_TIME,rls.REFORM_SCHEME,rls.MEMO) IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(rls.COMPLETE_TIME,rls.REFORM_SCHEME,rls.MEMO) <> '' ) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS MEASURES_FLAG,
COUNT(a.QUESTION_CONTENT) AS COUNTY_COUNT, CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IS_SUBMIT, CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '3' THEN '1' ELSE '-1' END AS IS_BACK, b.guoku_dscr AS COUNTY_DSCR
COUNT( CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' AND a.COUNTY <>'' AND a.COUNTY IS NOT NULL THEN a.QUESTION_CONTENT END) AS COUNTY_COUNT, CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' AND a.COUNTY <>'' AND a.COUNTY IS NOT NULL THEN b.guoku_dscr ELSE '' END AS COUNTY_DSCR, COUNT( CASE WHEN a.CITY <>'' AND a.CITY IS NOT NULL AND (a.COUNTY ='' OR a.COUNTY IS NULL) THEN a.QUESTION_CONTENT END) AS CITY_COUNT,
CASE WHEN a.CITY_STATE = '2' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IS_SUBMIT, CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' AND ( a.COUNTY <>'' AND a.COUNTY IS NOT NULL) AND a.CITY_STATE = '1' THEN '0' WHEN a.CITY_STATE = '3' THEN '1' ELSE '-1' END AS IS_BACK,
CASE WHEN a.CITY <>'' AND a.CITY IS NOT NULL AND (a.COUNTY ='' OR a.COUNTY IS NULL) THEN c.guoku_dscr ELSE '' END AS CITY_DSCR
COUNT( CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' AND a.COUNTY <>'' AND a.COUNTY IS NOT NULL THEN a.QUESTION_CONTENT END) AS COUNTY_COUNT, CASE WHEN a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' AND a.COUNTY <>'' AND a.COUNTY IS NOT NULL THEN b.guoku_dscr ELSE '' END AS COUNTY_DSCR, COUNT( CASE WHEN a.CITY_STATE = '2' AND a.CITY <>'' AND a.CITY IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(a.CITY,4) <> '2401' AND (a.COUNTY ='' OR a.COUNTY IS NULL) THEN a.QUESTION_CONTENT END) AS CITY_COUNT, CASE WHEN a.CITY_STATE = '2' AND a.CITY <>'' AND a.CITY IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(a.CITY,4) <> '2401' AND (a.COUNTY ='' OR a.COUNTY IS NULL) THEN c.guoku_dscr END AS CITY_DSCR, COUNT( CASE WHEN a.PROVINCE_STATE = '2' AND (a.COUNTY ='' OR a.COUNTY IS NULL) AND (a.CITY ='' OR a.CITY IS NULL) THEN a.QUESTION_CONTENT END ) AS PROVINCE_COUNT,
CASE WHEN a.PROVINCE_STATE = '2' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IS_SUBMIT, CASE WHEN a.CITY_STATE = '2' AND ( a.CITY <>'' AND a.CITY IS NOT NULL) AND a.PROVINCE_STATE = '1' THEN '0' WHEN a.PROVINCE_STATE = '3' THEN '1' ELSE '-1' END AS IS_BACK,
d.guoku_dscr AS PROVINCE_DSCR
FROM `inspection`.`inspection_self_ledger` a
LEFT JOIN `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` b ON a.COUNTY = b.guoku_id
LEFT JOIN `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` b ON a.COUNTY = b.guoku_id LEFT JOIN `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` c ON a.CITY = c.guoku_id
LEFT JOIN `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` b ON a.COUNTY = b.guoku_id LEFT JOIN `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` c ON a.CITY = c.guoku_id LEFT JOIN `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` d ON a.PROVINCE = d.guoku_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rl.`LEDGER_ID`, rl.IS_COMPLETE, CASE WHEN rl.COMPLETE_TIME IS NOT NULL OR rl.COMPLETE_TIME <> '' THEN CONCAT('完成时间：', rl.COMPLETE_TIME, '。') ELSE '' END AS COMPLETE_TIME, CASE WHEN rs.REFORM_SCHEME IS NOT NULL OR rs.REFORM_SCHEME <> '' THEN CONCAT('措施：', rs.REFORM_SCHEME, '。') ELSE '' END AS REFORM_SCHEME, CASE WHEN rs.MEMO IS NOT NULL OR rs.MEMO <> '' THEN CONCAT('说明：', rs.MEMO, '。') ELSE '' END AS MEMO FROM `inspection`.`inspection_reform_ledger` rl JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_reform_scheme` rs ON rl.`ID` = rs.`REFORM_ID` ) rls ON a.LEDGER_ID = rls.LEDGER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND a.ADD_DATE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.INSPECTION_TASK_YEAR}, '%')
AND a.COUNTY = #{params.COUNTY}
AND a.CITY = #{params.CITY} AND a.COUNTY_STATE = '2'
AND a.PROVINCE = #{params.PROVINCE} AND a.COUNTY_STATE = '2' AND a.CITY_STATE = '2'
GROUP BY a.LEDGER_ID, a.QUESTION_ID_1, a.QUESTION_ID_2, a.QUESTION_ID_3, a.QUESTION_CONTENT ORDER BY a.QUESTION_ID_1, a.QUESTION_ID_2, a.QUESTION_ID_3, a.QUESTION_CONTENT
